# Webex
> Webex provides collaboration, calling, meetings, messaging, events, webinars, and customer experience solutions for hybrid work.

Webex combines enterprise communications, customer experience, and developer platforms across meetings, calling, contact center, devices, and integrations.

## Product Documentation
- [Webex Help Center](https://help.webex.com/): Central product documentation for meetings, calling, messaging, devices, and administration.
- [Webex Suite](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nj6y7dcb/Webex-Suite): Overview of the integrated Webex collaboration suite and included capabilities.
- [Webex Meetings](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/WBX000026378/Webex-Meetings): Documentation for scheduling, joining, hosting, and managing meetings.
- [Webex Calling](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nwq4jxc/Webex-Calling): Documentation for cloud calling features, setup, and user workflows.
- [Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/njza5uf/Webex-Contact-Center): Guides for contact center administration, routing, and agent experiences.
- [Webex Webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/WBX9000031018/Webex-Webinars): Documentation for planning, hosting, and managing webinars and large events.
- [Webex Devices](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/WBX000028782/Webex-Devices): Help for room devices, desk devices, phones, and peripherals.

## Administration
- [Control Hub Help](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nj5p67g/Control-Hub): Admin guidance for organization setup, services, users, and analytics.
- [Webex Administration](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/WBX000026378/Webex-Administration): Administrative documentation across Webex services and deployments.
- [User Management](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nikzbgy/Add-users-manually-in-Control-Hub): Instructions for adding and managing users in Control Hub.
- [Single Sign-On](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/WBX000028782/Single-Sign-On-Integration-in-Control-Hub): SSO setup and identity integration for Webex organizations.
- [Analytics and Reports](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3ijtao/Analytics-for-Your-Cloud-Collaboration-Portfolio): Usage analytics and reporting for collaboration services.
- [Hybrid Services](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nx7f9adb/Deployment-Guide-for-Webex-Hybrid-Calendar-Service): Deployment guidance for Webex hybrid service integrations.

## Developer Platform
- [Webex for Developers](https://developer.webex.com/): Developer portal for APIs, SDKs, widgets, and integration resources.
- [API Reference](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1): REST API reference for Webex platform resources and operations.
- [Developer Guides](https://developer.webex.com/docs/guides): Conceptual and task-oriented guides for building Webex integrations.
- [Developer Blog](https://developer.webex.com/blog): Articles, announcements, and tutorials for the Webex developer ecosystem.
- [Developer Support](https://developer.webex.com/support): Support resources, FAQs, and community links for developers.
- [Developer Changelog](https://developer.webex.com/docs/changelog): Release notes and updates for APIs, SDKs, and platform changes.

## APIs
- [Messages API](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/messages): Send, retrieve, and manage messages in Webex spaces.
- [Meetings API](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/meetings): Create, update, and manage meetings programmatically.
- [Rooms API](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/rooms): Manage spaces, memberships, and collaboration contexts.
- [People API](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/people): Access user profiles, organization membership, and identity data.
- [Webhooks API](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/webhooks): Subscribe to Webex events and receive change notifications.
- [Devices API](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/devices): Manage devices and device-related information through the platform.
- [Recording API](https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/recordings): Access and manage meeting recordings and metadata.

## SDKs and Embedded Experiences
- [JavaScript SDK](https://developer.webex.com/docs/sdks/browser): Browser SDK for messaging, meetings, and embedded collaboration experiences.
- [Android SDK](https://developer.webex.com/docs/sdks/android): Native Android SDK for integrating Webex capabilities into mobile apps.
- [iOS SDK](https://developer.webex.com/docs/sdks/ios): Native iOS SDK for messaging and meeting experiences in apps.
- [Widgets](https://developer.webex.com/docs/widgets): Prebuilt UI components for embedding Webex collaboration features.
- [Embedded Apps](https://developer.webex.com/docs/embedded-apps): Build in-meeting and in-messaging embedded app experiences for Webex.
- [Integrations](https://developer.webex.com/docs/integrations): Create OAuth integrations and connect external applications to Webex.
